description: Random numbers for a lottery game, 1 to 10 sets. Either name a game: kr645 (Lotto 6/45 (South Korea)), powerball (Powerball (USA)), megamillions (Mega Millions (USA, matrix since 2025-04-08)), euromillions (EuroMillions), uk_lotto (Lotto (UK)), jp_loto6 (Loto 6 (Japan)), jp_loto7 (Loto 7 (Japan)), thunderball (Thunderball (UK)), set_for_life (Set For Life (UK)), fr_loto (Loto (France)), br_megasena (Mega-Sena (Brazil)), br_lotofacil (Lotofácil (Brazil)), br_quina (Quina (Brazil)), br_maismilionaria (+Milionária (Brazil)); or give your own format with game "custom": count numbers from min (default 1) to max, and optionally extra_count numbers from 1 to extra_max drawn apart (a bonus ball). The result page shows the seed that reproduces it. For a named game, put in what your user said (keep, leave_out, date, odd, sum_min, sum_max, text): the page shows every way at once, those filled. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

count.description: custom: how many numbers per set.

date.description: Named game: a date that matters to your user, YYYY-MM-DD; its day and month go into the line (the date way).

extra_count.description: custom: how many extra (bonus) numbers, drawn apart.

extra_max.description: custom: the largest extra number (extras start at 1).

game.description: A game, or "custom" with count and max. May be left out when count and max are given.

keep.description: Named game: numbers your user wants in every line. The page shows them drawn as the number-board way.

leave_out.description: Named game: numbers your user wants left out (the number-board way).

odd.description: Named game: how many odd numbers per line (the balanced way).

seed.description: Optional. 64 hex characters. Give the seed shown on an earlier result page to get the same result again (that is how a draw is checked). Leave it out for a fresh draw.

sum_max.description: Named game: the largest sum of a line (the balanced way).

sum_min.description: Named game: the smallest sum of a line (the balanced way).

text.description: Named game: your user's own words (a wish, a name, a dream). The page has them written in; prismtect.com draws numbers from them when your user presses send there.

name: pick_numbers
title: Pick lottery numbers
